survey: A wall clock seen face-on. The round orange rim is an even circle and frames the white dial. The dial has 12 hour marks, one at every position from 12 to 11, with rows of minute dots between them. A navy hour hand points at about 10 and a longer navy minute hand points at 2, so the clock reads about 10:10. A thin red second hand points down toward 6. All three hands start from one navy hub at the true centre of the dial, and the red hand starts from under the hub. The clock sits flat against the striped green background and casts a soft shadow. Nothing floats, no part passes through another and no parts are missing.
